## Shadow Corpus Note

The playtest harness now starts synthetic teams with truthful synced cap totals derived from scaled contract inputs. That intentionally changed frozen shadow reports, so `_canon/seeds/mfd` was regenerated as corpus `v2` with metadata classification `intended`, schema version `36`, and spec citation `_canon/seeds/mfd/README.md:25`. - `speedrunner-5y`: 85 anomalies, 0 high.
- `speedrunner-10y`: 218 anomalies, 0 high.
- `speedrunner-20y`: 1233 anomalies, 508 high in the known 800-step truncated corpus. This remains a frozen drift detector, not a 20-season cleanliness certificate.
